caption: Follow-up on #1096/#1119/#1128: a plain NORMAL-stance MOVE order still pauses while State.FIGHTING (unchanged), but now resumes or cancels once the fight genuinely ends, depending on whether the destination is still clear. Two evenly-matched Spearmen regiments lock into a sustained melee; at tick 300, mid-fight, the player is redirected to a point just past the clash. The order holds while contact continues, but once the engagement linger decays (~tick 332) the destination still sits inside the enemy's own footprint, so the order cancels outright instead of marching into occupied ground -- the unit falls straight back into the same fight rather than straying off.
